blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Flag carrier Philippine Airlines (PAL) begins its first week-long sale today on business class and premium economy seats, offering discounts of up to 40 percent on international flights and up to 60 percent on domestic routes. According to the Lucio Tan-led carrier, it will offer a 30-percent discount on base fare for international travel between November 1 and March 31, 2027, while travel from April 1, 2027 will carry discounts of up to 40 percent.
